verdict: Meta is performing well; Google's $1,016 spend with zero leads needs fixing.
narrative: This period, your Meta campaigns delivered 155 leads at an average cost of $16.84 per lead — and efficiency is improving, with cost per lead dropping 31% and leads up 37% in the most recent week alone. Google Ads, however, recorded zero conversions on $1,015.77 in spend over the same 28 days, with the top search campaign accounting for $736 of that with no measurable return. Conversion tracking on Google is being reviewed and corrective action is already in motion; offline conversion data is scheduled to be connected by end of September, which will give Google's campaigns real signal to optimize against. Next period, expect continued Meta momentum and a clearer picture of Google's true performance as tracking is resolved.
